item.title: India Celebrates a Decade of Startup Innovation and Growth
item.description: India Celebrates a Decade of Startup Innovation and Growth India's startup ecosystem is celebrating a decade of extraordinary growth, driven by the Startup India initiative, which has revolutionized the economic landscape. Official data shows that more than 50 new startups are birthed every day, highlighting an unprecedented boom across the nation.Union Minister Piyush Goyal commemorated the achievement, emphasizing the initiative's transformative impact on job creation and economic empowerment.
